name: Surya Srekanth
headline: MERN Full Stack Dev | Applied AI | Python Dev | Quality Data Analyst
summary: Textile quality professional with 5+ years of experience in yarn testing and laboratory data analysis, now building skills as a Python and MERN full stack developer. Currently analyze test data and produce quality reports using internal software at SITRA, and have deployed two AI-powered web apps using Python, Streamlit and the Gemini API. Pursuing a B.Sc. in Computer Science; seeking a junior full stack or applied AI role where textile and industrial data knowledge is an advantage.

work_experience.title: Testing Assistant (Data Analysis & Reporting)
highlights: Tested and analyzed yarn samples on Uster Classimat 5, identifying thick places, thin places, neps, hairiness and contamination.
Analyze test results and generate quality reports using SITRA's internal reporting software, turning raw data into defect findings that support corrective action and reduce material waste.
Follow calibration schedules and laboratory protocols to keep test results accurate and repeatable.

work_experience.title: Assistant Technician
highlights: Assembled, serviced and maintained flat knitting machines for reliable production.
Performed preventive maintenance that contributed to a 15–20% reduction in machine downtime.
Developed knitting programs in M1+ software for fabric development.
